gui.clawdcrafter.rule.clear_volume.desc: Clears out all the blocks in the constraints and turns them to empty air before building.
gui.clawdcrafter.rule.replace.desc: Makes the build completely but doesn't clear everything beforehand: it only replaces the existing blocks with the blocks that exist in the projected build.
gui.clawdcrafter.rule.only_where_possibl: Places parts of the projected build wherever there is an empty air block available, without replacing or deleting anything that already exists.
